correspondences.notes: Bundles replacement sidecars of several suffixes; info.txt and destination.fif have no BIDS counterpart.

brainlife.desc: Sidecar-only companion to neuro/meg/fif: replacement channels.tsv, head positions, destination, events.tsv and info.txt from MEG Apps.
brainlife.name: neuro/meg/fif-override

original.desc: This datatype augments the original neuro/meg/fif data with various extra information, such as bad channels stored in channels.tsv, and bad epoch (TODO which file stores this?)

file_descs.channels: channels.tsv containing any columns that were not present on the original channels.tsv. For example, "status" column could contain good/bad values to indicate that the channel should be removed from the further processing. Please see https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/latest/04-modality-specific-files/03-electroencephalography.html#channels-description-_channelstsv for full descriptions.

brainlife.readme:
channels.tsv  
> https://bids-specification.readthedocs.io/en/latest/04-modality-specific-files/03-electroencephalography.html#channels-description-_channelstsv

**Use for:** Passing bad channels, head positions and events between MEG Apps without rewriting the FIF.

**Not for:** Standalone data: it only makes sense next to the recording it describes. BIDS export of events.tsv when it holds index lists instead of events.

**BIDS:** meg/channels (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 9 Apps, output of 9 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meg.fif-override.json

files.desc: BIDS channels.tsv with updated status (e.g. bad channels found by an App).
Time-varying head positions (.pos) computed from cHPI.
Mean head-position transform (destination.fif) to realign runs.
events.tsv from event detection; some Apps store bad-epoch or ICA indices here instead.
Text dump (info.txt) of MNE measurement info, for inspection.

identifying_risks: info.txt can print subject_info, measurement date and head digitisation.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level sidecar metadata linkable through a participant code.
sharing_cautions: Check info.txt before sharing; drop it if it shows identity fields.
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if info.txt shows subject_info (name, birth date) or the measurement date.
